info.name: Alfred - Core API
info.description: Core module: sessions, messages, command executions, memories, working memory, embeddings, transcription. Run in order — each section builds on the previous (session → message → command execution). Note: embedding requests (60-62) call the OpenAI API and require OPENAI_API_KEY to be set; transcription (80) calls the Gemini API and requires GEMINI_API_KEY to be set.
